newsitem.title: USA: Intl Marketing says Stamm appointed CEO.
newsitem.headline: Intl Marketing says Stamm appointed CEO.

text.p: International Marketing Management Inc said Monday it has removed Peter Boonen as president and has appointed Michael Stamm as chief executive officer.

The company also said in a statement that after testing, two wells have been designated as tight holes. Both wells are drilling in southeastern Colorado. The company did give any further information on the wells' status.

The company also said in its release it has terminated all relations with Vanity A.V.V., a company of which Boonen is a director. All shares issued to Boonen, Vanity A.V.V. and others for which no consideration was paid, have been canceled and returned to the company, it said.
"The directors believe that this action is in the best interest of the company," the statement said.
No one at International Marketing was available for comment.
